summary: Test suite only covers expiry computation and urgency classification functions (~20% of core modules). Critically missing: CLI argument parsing, config file loading, report generation, formatter output validation (JSON/markdown), and GitHub Actions workflow testing. Fails explicit requirement that 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT'—provides only local Bun unit tests with no act-based test harness or workflow validation. Would not catch regressions in CLI, formatters, error handling, or report generation.
